exam_price_notes: Administered by employers or institutions; candidates typically do not pay directly.

lifecycle.summary: Wonderlic no longer sells the Wonderlic Personnel Test as a named product. Its page is gone ('Whoops Page not found') and Wonderlic's current catalogue is two platforms - 'Wonderlic Select Make the right hire with data-driven insights into potential and fit. Wonderlic Develop Develop high-performing people and teams with insights tailored to their roles.' - in which the WPT's cognitive test now appears only as one section of a combined score: 'Most candidates complete the full Wonderlic Select assessment in about 35 minutes. The 12-minute, timed portion of the test contains 50 questions'. Neither 'Wonderlic Personnel Test' nor 'WPT' appears anywhere on wonderlic.com, and the issuer publishes no retirement notice or date.
